text: {"lessons":["Selling winners too quickly can mean missing further gains; I should base sale decisions on my investment plan, not just the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","I should evaluate each stock as part of my whole portfolio, rather than judging it only by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","Buying more after declines can deepen losses if my original reasoning no longer holds; I should reassess the outlook and manage risk before adding."]}
